Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: pixel-art horse-and-knight idle animation, THREE complete poses on one horizontal transparent sprite sheet. Edit the provided reference. Preserve the EXACT same blue-white knight, face, plume, helmet, armor, shield, diagonal wooden lance, saddlecloth, white horse, black mane/tail, crisp dark pixel outlines and limited soft blue-white palette. All three figures face LEFT and have identical sizes, identical body/horse barrel height and identical rider/head/neck/torso positions relative to each figure's origin. ONLY change the horse's four legs below the body, not the rider or upper horse. Three evenly spaced complete figures, generous margins, no captions, no ground/shadows.
CRITICAL CORRECT POSES, left to right:
1) BOTH FRONT LEGS lifted TOGETHER. Both front knees bent sharply FORWARD toward the horse's head (left) and both front hooves curled up, distinctly off the ground. TWO REAR LEGS extend down, straight, weight-bearing, both rear hooves on the same ground line. Show two separate front bent legs and two separate planted rear legs.
2) ALL FOUR LEGS straight down, standing squarely. TWO FRONT legs underneath chest plus TWO REAR legs underneath rump. All four hooves clearly visible and touching the same ground line. No lifted knee, no diagonal stride.
3) BOTH FRONT LEGS straight down and planted. BOTH REAR LEGS lifted TOGETHER and folded FORWARD under the belly toward the front of the horse (toward left). Both rear hooves are up in front of their hips, NOT kicked backward. Two clearly separate straight front legs, two clearly separate bent lifted rear legs.
Each pose must have exactly FOUR anatomically connected legs and FOUR distinct hooves; far legs slightly offset to remain readable. The horse's torso, neck and rider DO NOT rise, tilt or sway. Maintain leg-to-belly and saddlecloth continuity. This is front-pair raise, neutral four-leg stand, rear-pair forward raise; NOT a walking/running or single-leg alternating gait. The reference poses are INCORRECT; replace their leg configurations with the above exact specification. Keep the original visual identity and pixel-art style.
